titles: 2022년 총격 391건 스웨덴…한국에선 총격이 드문 진짜 이유
"2022년 총격 391건" 스웨덴과 한국 치안이 갈린 진짜 이유
민간 총 94%를 경찰이 보관한다…스웨덴과 한국 치안이 갈린 이유
thumbnail_texts: "11살에게 2천만 원" / 한국에선 이 계산이 안 선다

image_concepts.A: 같은 밤, 두 도시 — 왼쪽 경광등 켜진 스톡홀름 외곽 / 가운데 익명의 스웨덴 형사 / 오른쪽 불 밝힌 서울 골목과 CCTV
image_concepts.B: 총이 있는 곳 — 왼쪽 압수된 권총 무더기 / 오른쪽 경찰서 보관함에 잠긴 엽총

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 A 실사 3분할. 왼쪽 밤의 스톡홀름 외곽 아파트 앞 폴리스라인과 파란 경광등, 가운데 굳은 표정의 익명 스웨덴 형사, 오른쪽 따뜻한 가로등 아래 사람들이 걷는 서울 골목과 CCTV.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic high-saturation HDR cinematic three-panel composition at night. On the left, a Stockholm suburb apartment block behind blue-and-white police tape with flashing blue police lights in cold desaturated tones, a Swedish national flag (blue with yellow Nordic cross) waving in the top-left corner. In the center, an anonymous attractive Swedish detective in his 50s with a likeable face and a shocked, exaggerated expression, shown chest-up and filling most of the frame height. On the right, a bright Seoul alley at 11 p.m. with warm orange streetlights, people walking calmly and a CCTV pole glowing with cool white-blue light, the South Korean national flag (Taegukgi) waving in the top-right corner.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 A 실사 변형. 인물 없이 화면을 반으로 나눠, 왼쪽 경광등에 물든 스톡홀름 거리와 오른쪽 통합관제센터 모니터 벽이 비추는 서울 야경.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic cinematic split-screen at night, vivid saturated tones. The left half shows an empty Stockholm suburban street washed in flashing blue police light, police tape stretched across a bicycle path, cold and desaturated with a Swedish national flag in the top-left corner. The right half shows a bright Korean CCTV integrated control center with a wall of glowing monitors displaying calm Seoul streets, an operator silhouette in front, warm and confident lighting with the South Korean national flag in the top-right corner. Large, clear subjects readable at small mobile size.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 B 실사 좌우 대비. 왼쪽 증거실 테이블 위 압수 권총 무더기와 증거 태그, 오른쪽 경찰서 보관함에 번호표를 달고 정렬된 엽총.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic high-contrast HDR still life split into two halves. On the left, a dim evidence room table piled with seized black pistols and ammunition magazines, yellow evidence tags attached, harsh overhead light and gritty desaturated tones, a Swedish national flag in the top-left corner. On the right, a clean, brightly lit Korean police station gun storage cabinet with hunting shotguns standing in a perfect row, each with a numbered tag, behind a locked steel grid, bright white-cyan lighting with the South Korean national flag in the top-right corner. Dramatically oversized objects filling the upper half.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 B 실사 인물형. 가운데 놀란 표정의 익명 한국 50대 사냥꾼이 경찰서 창구에서 엽총을 반납하는 장면, 왼쪽 위 압수 권총 실루엣과 스웨덴 국기.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic cinematic close-up of an anonymous attractive Korean hunter in his 50s with a warm likeable face and a surprised, exaggerated expression, handing a hunting shotgun across a police station counter to an officer, bright clean lighting with cyan accents. In the top-left, a dark inset of seized smuggled pistols on a table under cold light beside a Swedish national flag (blue with yellow Nordic cross); in the top-right, the South Korean national flag waving. Strong contrast between the dark left corner and the bright Korean scene.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 와일드카드. 스웨덴 국기가 걸린 깃대 아래로 경찰차 경광등 불빛이 번지는 스톡홀름 광장과, 같은 시각 불 켜진 편의점 앞 테이블에 노트북을 두고 자리를 비운 서울 장면을 대각선으로 맞붙임.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic vivid cinematic split composition with a diagonal dividing line. Left half of the upper area: a Stockholm square at night with a Swedish flag on a flagpole and blurred blue police lights reflecting on wet cobblestones, tense and cold. Right half of the upper area: a bright Seoul convenience store terrace at the same hour, a laptop and a smartphone left unattended on an outdoor table under warm light, calm and safe, with the South Korean national flag subtly visible in the top-right corner. Bold contrast between cold blue and warm yellow, key objects large and placed in the upper half.
